dict.string: Browses all icons of the current Font Awesome Free release. Replaces LaunchBar's built-in action, which is stuck on Font Awesome 4.7.
Optional search text. Unlike LaunchBar's own filtering it also matches Font Awesome's search terms, so "notification" finds the bell icon.
Return copies the CSS classes, ⌘ the LaunchBar icon string, ⌥ the glyph, ⌃ the HTML tag, ⇧ opens the icon on fontawesome.com.
The Font Awesome Free OTFs in ~/Library/Fonts. The action offers to download them if they are missing, and can update itself to newer Font Awesome releases.
Font Awesome Free by Fonticons, Inc. — Icons: CC BY 4.0, Fonts: SIL OFL 1.1
